distribution.title: The aim of this project is to develop a rigorous and systematic framework for the fuzzy modeling of decision-making problems with uncertainties in ecological management applications. This includes the solution and qualitative analysis of related optimal control problems, as well as the development of recommendations for decision-makers about acquiring new information. To achieve the aim, specific fuzzy logic based modelling tools will be developed and fuzzy model based optimal control techniques will be developed and applied to pollution control and renewable resource extraction problems.
